name: base
purpose: default slopes; reset held at start with vin above the clamp; peak hold, hold against a lower input, release down, peak up, release to a negative input (clamp at 0), release upward, peak above 0.8 V (clamp), asynchronous clear between samples, clear 1 ns after a sample that turns metric mid-ramp, a sample while rst is high, release down and up after reset

name: rate-override
purpose: rise_rate = 1.5e8 V/s and fall_rate = 6e8 V/s, so falls are faster than rises; vin starts at 0.4 V with rst low; samples 5 ns apart land inside rising ramps: a peak-hold sample with vin between the output and its target, a release that turns metric down mid-ramp; a clear 2 ns into a rising ramp

name: reset-and-start
purpose: mode high and rst low at t = 0 with vin = 0.6 V, so the outputs must stay at 0 V until the first sample; a clear during the first rise; three samples while rst is high with vin and mode changing; release, hold of a lower and an equal input, peak at the 1.2 V input limit, release to the -0.5 V limit; a short rst pulse with the target already at 0; a clear 1 ns after a release

name: vth-override
purpose: vth 0.8 V with 200 ps control edges, rise_rate 4e9 V/s (legal maximum) and fall_rate 1e9 V/s: a 0.45 V threshold samples and clears 77.8 ps early, beyond the 50 ps event tolerance; vin starts at 0.5 V; peak hold, hold against a lower input, release down, an asynchronous clear, a sample while rst is high, peak above 0.8 V (clamp), release to a negative input (clamp at 0), release up, and a last clear 22.2 ps before the end of the run
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0

ahdl_include "dut.va"

Vvin (vin 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0.5 7.5n 0.5 8.5n 0.3 12.5n 0.3 13.5n 0.2 17.5n 0.2 18.5n 0.6 22.5n 0.6 23.5n 0.9 27.5n 0.9 28.5n 0.6 32.5n 0.6 33.5n -0.2 37.5n -0.2 38.5n 0.7 45n 0.7]
Vclk (clk 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 5n 0 5.2n 0.9 7.5n 0.9 7.7n 0 10n 0 10.2n 0.9 12.5n 0.9 12.7n 0 15n 0 15.2n 0.9 17.5n 0.9 17.7n 0 20n 0 20.2n 0.9 22.5n 0.9 22.7n 0 25n 0 25.2n 0.9 27.5n 0.9 27.7n 0 30n 0 30.2n 0.9 32.5n 0.9 32.7n 0 35n 0 35.2n 0.9 37.5n 0.9 37.7n 0 40n 0 40.2n 0.9 42.5n 0.9 42.7n 0 45n 0]
Vmode (mode 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 12n 0 12.2n 0.9 23n 0.9 23.2n 0 32n 0 32.2n 0.9 45n 0.9]
Vrst (rst 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 18n 0 18.2n 0.9 22n 0.9 22.2n 0 44.8n 0 45n 0.9]

XDUT (vin clk mode rst out metric) slew_envelope_tracker vth=0.8 rise_rate=4e9 fall_rate=1e9

tran tran stop=45n maxstep=50p strobeperiod=50p
save vin clk mode rst out metric
